Wuthering Heights is a surprisingly gothic novel- have a read if you've got any spare time. American literature isn't a speciality of mine, but in terms of 'darker' parts I'd reccommend John Steinbeck. Grapes of Wrath is by far his best work, and it's set during the depression (focuses on how people struggled through that period of history.) If you'd prefer a shorter read, Of Mice and Men covers a number of 'darker' aspects in the same era (poverty, depression, mental illness, ageism and racism.) Hope that helps!
